ports.note: Area is acquisition context for OSM; file inputs do not require it.

ontology.note: GeoSPARQL geometry, PROV activity and QUDT buffer units. The mode the graph was filtered for is asserted as fw:travelMode on the network entity -- the term reachability already uses for the mode it assumes -- from src/catchments.ts, so it is declared on the release whose definition is that module rather than here. Configuration SHACL is future work.

changes.description: A street network can be read from a published OpenStreetMap extract the practitioner already holds -- a .osm.pbf from Geofabrik or anywhere else -- instead of being downloaded from a query service. The file stays on the device, is read where it sits, and is clipped to the study area while it is decoded; only the network it yields is kept. No province extracts are published for most countries, so the file is a country and serves every province and every workflow after the first. The work is done by Graphways' Rust core compiled to WebAssembly and shipped in this build: see vendor/street-engine-NOTICE.txt. Measured on 2026-10-22: a province's driving network, 122,061 junctions, from a 416 MB extract.
The travel mode is offered on the extract path too, because it decides what is read and at province scale it decides how much.

evidence.note: Acquisition only; the graph it produces is checked where it is used. The pacing follows the service's own /api/status rather than a client-side guess, measured against OSMnx's behaviour on 2026-10-19.
